description: Search AI use cases with hybrid full-text and vector ranking. Supports provider, industry, geography, technology, customer, partner, and boolean case-type filters. Filters work without a query, for example customer_name alone lists that company's deployments, including spelling variants and units grouped on its hub company page (Nestle also finds Nestlé). Results link to the original source (Url), the hub record (HubUrl) and hub company pages (CompanyPages).

cloud_provider.description: Provider filter, one value or comma-separated. Cloud platforms: Microsoft, AWS, GCP, Oracle, IBM, Alibaba. AI and data platforms: Databricks, Snowflake, Nvidia, OpenAI, Anthropic. Open source: OpenSource.

country.description: Filter by country code, for example US or GB.

customer_name.description: Filter by the company adopting AI. Spelling variants and units on the company's hub page are included.

limit.description: Maximum results requested. Public previews return at most 3; personal-key access permits up to 20.

name: hybrid_search_usecases
title: Search AI deployments with filters
